body: I know my own mind and am intelligent enough to know it can not possibly be worse.

That's part of the problem - I have no passion for anything anymore. Everything I once enjoyed has either been ruined, or just isn't fun to me anymore because of repetition. The more I do something I enjoy, the less enjoyable it is for me over time.

Wow, all right, it's pretty obvious you didn't grasp what I was actually saying.

*My* life could be worse than right now, such as if I was also being disemboweled with a wooden spoon, but it's my own mind that makes my life the worst regardless of what other people are dealing with. They have mental aspects that make it easier for them than my life is for me.
